name: Black Bean, Potato, Zucchini & Corn Soup in Creamy Coconut Broth
ingredients: 48 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel and medium dice carrots and potatoes; place both in a medium bowl.
Trim celery and cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl with the carrot and potato.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and medium dice zucchini.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
When the veggies are soft, add beans, zucchini, thyme, broth, coconut milk, and corn to the pot. Stir to combine the soup, cover, and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Once the soup is simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Juice lemon into the soup and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
